chaos_eye.line.infect: ...Found you. Hold still - this eye is mine now.
chaos_eye.line.pleased.0: Does it hurt? Good. I do love watching you hurt.
chaos_eye.line.pleased.1: Oh, you're bleeding. Interesting. Keep going.
chaos_eye.line.pleased.2: You think pain is bad? Around here it's the entry ticket.
chaos_eye.line.bored.0: Just standing there? I'm bored enough to make my own fun.
chaos_eye.line.bored.1: All this time and nothing done. I'm falling asleep.
chaos_eye.line.bored.2: Want me to find you some trouble? Silence counts as yes.
chaos_eye.line.excited.0: Oh? Now this is a fight. I'm betting on you - don't lose me money.
chaos_eye.line.excited.2: Blood tastes good, doesn't it? I can smell it.
chaos_eye.line.disappointed.0: You ran? I thought you had at least some spine.
chaos_eye.line.disappointed.1: Took a hit and didn't swing back. Pathetic.
chaos_eye.line.disappointed.2: How dull. Even the dice are blushing for you.
chaos_eye.line.furious.0: You died. ...Fine. I'm putting this on your tab.
chaos_eye.line.furious.1: One death, is that all? It matters. I hold grudges.
chaos_eye.line.furious.2: Get up. You still owe me.
item.aunique-epic.heroes_expedition.sile: Carry it, and the Eye of Chaos will look away.
item.aunique-epic.heroes_expedition.reso: Strength while armed, but hunger drains faster
item.aunique-epic.heroes_expedition.unbr: Kill at half health for brief Regeneration
item.aunique-epic.heroes_expedition.burd: Armor only 60% effective, damage taken doubled
item.aunique-epic.heroes_expedition.cris: Debuffs -25% duration, but fire and venom kill
item.aunique-epic.heroes_expedition.hint: Active anywhere in your inventory · Right-click to equip in the Necklace slot
